# CorePhia

> CorePhia is a physician-built weight loss program based in Tampa, Florida. The program combines dietitian services, a comprehensive exercise plan, regular follow-ups, and medical care, with weight loss medication only when a licensed provider decides it is clinically appropriate. It is a program, not a pharmacy or a medication product. Patients must be located in Florida.

## Key facts

- Location: Tampa, Florida. Patients must be located in Florida, where the provider is licensed.
- Legal name: CorePhia Health PLLC.
- Who can join: adults 18 or older.
- Cost: monthly membership, cash pay. Core is $299 a month, Core Complete is $349 a month.
- Insurance: not accepted.
- Payment: the patient chooses a plan at the end of the intake form and adds a card on a secure sign-up page. The card is charged only once the provider accepts the patient and the practice activates the membership; it is then billed monthly and renews automatically. To cancel, the patient calls or emails CorePhia.
- Getting started: an online intake that takes about ten minutes, then a review by a licensed provider.
- Medication: prescribed only when a licensed provider decides it is clinically appropriate. Many patients follow the program without it.

## Programs

- [Medical care](https://corephia.com/programs/medical-care): A licensed provider reviews your history and guides your care.
- [Dietitian services](https://corephia.com/programs/dietitian-services): A meal plan built around your goals, preferences, and lifestyle.
- [Comprehensive exercise plan](https://corephia.com/programs/exercise-plan): Workouts tailored to your fitness level.
- [Follow-ups](https://corephia.com/programs/follow-ups): Regular check-ins and progress tracking.
